body: When I was invited to participate in Animate, I needed another project on my plate like I needed a kick in the shins. But the more I learned, the more intrigued I was, and I couldn’t say no. After watching Animate take shape, all I can say is … check it out. It’s an amazing resource – for a small group, a class, a youth group, a retreat, maybe even a Sunday series. I’m honored to be part of it. For more info: animate.wearesparkhouse.org .
